title: Documentation of GHO
tagline: Improvements and recommendations on the documentation for the GHO stable coin.
description:
I have almost four years of analyzing DeFi documentation full time and in the last six months I've been looking particularly at stable coin documentation. My project is an analysis and set of recommendations for the website documentation.

The output of this project is the readme document on my GitHub and the video only.
how_its_made:
The output of this project is the readme document on my GitHub and the video only.  

The article is a set of suggestions only. We are more than willing to help in improvements but I wanted to work with the team and ensure the improvement would be implemented on the documentation.
